fields.Name: W1 -> S5.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.30 (phase 2, dataset W1, criterion S5.3): every candidate's inner-CV score is a mean over repeated folds with a 95% interval, 100% of candidates; 0 candidates are pruned while their upper bound is >= the leader's lower bound; the winner's inner-CV score is labelled optimistically biased. The pytest node tests/gates/test_trainer_contract_gates.py::test_W1_S5_3_inner_cv_means_with_intervals: 5x3 grouped folds, every candidate scored on all 15. The trainer prunes nothing, so the mutation is a substitute: it fails when one candidate is scored on fewer folds than the others (14 of 15).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every candidate's inner score is the mean over 15 grouped folds inside its interval; nothing pruned (1 of 1 pytest case).
